groups_guide.title: Groups Guide
groups_guide.how_to_create_body:
1. Go to the main Chat screen and tap the plus icon (+) in the header.

2. Select members from the online users list (you can select multiple users by tapping on them).

3. Tap "Create" or "Add" button at the top (it will show "Create" if you don't have a group, or "Add" if you already have a group). With a group already, you then pick which group they join (or start a new one while you have fewer than two).

4. If creating a new group, enter a group name (required, max 50 characters) in the modal that appears.

5. Tap "Create Group" to finalize.

6. Selected members will receive invitations to join your group.
groups_guide.rule_group_limit_body: Each user can be the admin/creator of up to two groups at a time.
groups_guide.rule_min_members_body: A group must have at least 2 members (including yourself).
groups_guide.rule_max_members_body: Each group can have up to 15 members.
groups_guide.rule_group_admin_body: The creator is the admin. Admins can remove members and make other members admin.
groups_guide.rule_admin_transfer_body: If an admin (not creator) makes another member admin, they will revert to a regular member. The creator always remains admin.
groups_guide.rule_leaving_body: Members can leave at any time. If an admin/creator leaves, a new admin is randomly selected. If the last member leaves, the group is deleted.
groups_guide.rule_invitations_body: Members must accept invitations before they can join.
groups_guide.features_body:
• Send text messages, images, and fruits (up to 18 fruits per message).

• See who's online in your group.

• View group members and their roles.

• Receive notifications for new messages when you're not active in the chat.

chat_rules_modal.title: Community Chat Rules
chat_rules_modal.rule_1: Always communicate respectfully. Hate speech, discrimination, and harassment are strictly prohibited.
chat_rules_modal.rule_2: Avoid sharing offensive, explicit, or inappropriate content, including text, images, or links.
chat_rules_modal.rule_3: Do not share personal, sensitive, or confidential information such as phone numbers, addresses, or financial details.
chat_rules_modal.rule_4: Spamming, repetitive messaging, or promoting products/services without permission is not allowed.
chat_rules_modal.rule_5: If you encounter inappropriate behavior, use the report or block tools available in the app.
chat_rules_modal.rule_6: Use appropriate language in the chat. Avoid abusive or overly aggressive tones.
chat_rules_modal.rule_7: Discussions or activities promoting illegal or unethical behavior are prohibited.
chat_rules_modal.rule_8: Users are responsible for the content they share and must adhere to community guidelines.
chat_rules_modal.rule_9: Moderators reserve the right to monitor and take action on any violations, including warnings or bans.
chat_rules_modal.rule_10: Content should be suitable for all approved age groups, adhering to app age requirements.
chat_rules_modal.rule_11: Do not share links to harmful sites, malware, or malicious content.
chat_rules_modal.rule_12: By using the chat feature, you agree to the app’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.https://bloxfruitscalc.com/privacy-policy/

guides.values_1: All fruit values are community-driven and update regularly based on real trading data.
guides.values_2: Values are shown in Normal and Permanent variants.
guides.values_3: Demand scores (🔥) show how popular a fruit currently is in the trading community.
guides.values_4: Use the search and filters to quickly find any fruit by name or category.
guides.values_5: Trending fruits on the home screen show what's rising or falling in value.
guides.calculator_1: Add fruits to the "You Give" and "You Get" sides to check if a trade is fair.
guides.calculator_2: The calculator shows win/lose/fair result based on current values.
guides.calculator_3: Toggle between Normal and Permanent fruit values.
guides.calculator_4: Share your trade with the community to get opinions from other traders.
guides.calculator_5: Save frequently used trades for quick access later.
guides.leaderboard_1: Browse the top traders ranked by rating, completed trades, and XP level.
guides.leaderboard_2: See trader stats: rating count, average rating, trading volume, and join date.
guides.leaderboard_3: Tap on any trader to view their public profile and trade history.
guides.leaderboard_4: Send a private message to a top trader to negotiate deals.
guides.leaderboard_5: Follow top traders to get recommendations and learn trading strategies.
guides.trading_1: Go to the Trades tab to browse active trade listings from the community.
guides.trading_2: Create your own trade by tapping "+ New Trade" and selecting fruits you want to give & get.
guides.trading_3: Chat privately with traders to negotiate — you'll see typing indicators and read receipts.
guides.trading_4: Use the Trade Calculator to check if a trade is fair before accepting!
guides.trading_5: Use the filter icons at the top of the Trades tab — 👤 My Trades, 👥 Following, 🔖 Saved — to instantly find your own, followed, or saved trades.
guides.mystuff_1: 🍇 My Fruits — Add your owned fruits to see your total portfolio value and demand breakdown.
guides.mystuff_2: ⭐ Goals — Add dream fruits to your wishlist and track progress towards getting them.
guides.chat_1: 💬 Private Chat — Tap any user to open a private chat and negotiate trades directly.
guides.chat_2: 👥 Group Chats — Join or create group chats to discuss trading strategies with the community.
guides.chat_3: See "typing..." in the header when the other person is typing. Grey ✓ = delivered. Blue ✓✓ = seen.
guides.chat_4: Send images, share fruits, and use quick message templates for fast replies.
guides.chat_5: Long-press any message to copy, translate, or report suspicious behavior.
guides.rating_1: Open a private chat with any user and exchange at least 3 messages each.
guides.rating_2: Once 3 messages are exchanged, the ⭐ Rate button appears at the top of the chat.
guides.rating_3: Tap the stars to set 1–5 rating, optionally add a written review, then submit.
guides.rating_4: You can edit your rating anytime by tapping the ⭐ Edit Rating button.
guides.rating_5: Honest ratings help the community find trustworthy traders and stay safe!
guides.games_1: 🍋 Mystery Fruit — Open mystery fruits to win cosmetic items for your profile!
guides.games_2: 🚀 Fruit Crash — Place your bet and cash out before it crashes. Test your nerves!
guides.games_3: 🍎 Smash — Tap quickly to break fruits and score points!
guides.games_4: 🔐 Chest — Pick the right chest to find treasure!
guides.games_5: ⚡ Slash — Swipe to slash fruits before time runs out!
guides.games_6: 🃏 Memory — Match fruit pairs in this classic memory game!
guides.games_7: 🏅 Game Ranks — Check your ranking on the Game Leaderboard to see how you compare!
guides.games_8: Mini games earn you XP, cosmetics, and help you level up faster.
guides.cosmetics_1: Go to "My Cosmetics" to view your avatar items: frames, backgrounds, badges.
guides.cosmetics_2: Equip cosmetics to customize your profile and show off your style!
guides.cosmetics_3: Win cosmetics by playing mystery games, daily spins, and seasonal events.
guides.cosmetics_4: Your equipped cosmetics are displayed on your profile and in chats.
guides.cosmetics_5: Some cosmetics are limited edition — collect them before they're gone!
guides.design_1: Post updates about your trades, wins, and trading stories in the Design tab.
guides.design_2: Like and comment on other traders' posts to build community connections.
guides.design_3: Share trading tips, market analysis, and fruit predictions with the community!
guides.design_4: Your posts earn you XP and help build your trader reputation.
guides.design_5: Report inappropriate posts by long-pressing and selecting the report option.
guides.badges_1: Earn XP by logging in daily, rating traders, completing trades, playing games, and posting.
guides.badges_2: Badges are awarded when you hit milestones — e.g., 5 ratings, 10 trades, etc.
guides.badges_3: Your badges are shown on your profile for everyone to see.
guides.badges_4: Higher-tier badges (Uncommon, Rare) require more activity — keep going!
guides.badges_5: Daily login streaks give bonus XP — don't break your streak!
guides.profile_1: Tap your avatar in Settings to edit your display name, bio, and profile picture.
guides.profile_2: Add your owned fruits and wishlist so other traders know what you have & want.
guides.profile_3: Other users can see your profile by tapping your name in any chat.
guides.profile_4: Your rating, badges, XP level, and trade history are all visible on your profile.
guides.profile_5: Equip cosmetics to customize your profile frame, background, and badges!
guides.profile_6: Follow traders you trust to easily find them later in the Friends section.
guides.safety_1: Never share your Roblox password or login info with anyone.
guides.safety_2: If a deal sounds too good to be true, it probably is — be cautious.
guides.safety_3: Use the official Roblox trading system inside the game to complete trades.
guides.safety_4: Check a trader's rating and reviews on their profile before trading with them.
guides.reporting_1: If someone is scamming or being inappropriate in private chat, tap the "Report Chat" button at the top of the conversation.
guides.reporting_2: The Report Chat button appears after both users have exchanged a few messages (same time as Rate Trader).
guides.reporting_3: Select a reason for reporting (Scam, Inappropriate, Harassment, Spam, or Other) and submit.
guides.reporting_4: By reporting, you give moderators permission to view the conversation so they can investigate fairly.
guides.reporting_5: Moderators can ONLY see chats that have been reported with consent — they cannot browse anyone's messages freely.
guides.reporting_6: Your report helps keep the community safe. Moderators will review it and take action if needed.

spot_the_fake.tagline: Smash the rotten fruits before they escape!
spot_the_fake.rule1_desc: Tap the red rotten fruits quickly! Letting one escape costs 1 life.
spot_the_fake.rule2_desc: Tapping a green fresh fruit costs 1 life. You only have 3!
spot_the_fake.rule3_desc: Stars are worth +25. Smash 3+ in a row for combo bonus points!

safe_cracker.tagline: Can you unlock the treasure chest? 💰
safe_cracker.rule1_desc: The dial spins nonstop. Tap STOP when the GOLDEN number reaches the arrow ▼ at the top!
safe_cracker.rule2_desc: Each lock spins the opposite way, like a real safe. Every chest you crack makes the dial faster!
safe_cracker.rule3_desc: Stop on the wrong number and the chest jams. Game Over!

quick_draw.tagline: How fast are your reflexes, pirate?
quick_draw.rule1_desc: The screen turns dark red. WAIT patiently. Don't tap yet!
quick_draw.rule2_desc: When it turns GREEN and says "SLASH!" — TAP fast!
quick_draw.rule3_desc: Tapping before the signal (or guessing it) adds a 999ms penalty to your average.
quick_draw.rule4_desc: Your fastest slash goes on the leaderboard. Under 200ms = LIGHTNING! ⚡
quick_draw.early_guess: Faster than humanly possible — that was a guess! 😜

memory_match.tagline: Find all the matching fruit pairs! 🧠
memory_match.rule1_desc: Tap any card to reveal the fruit hidden underneath!
memory_match.rule2_desc: Flip 2 cards — if they match, they stay! Fewer moves = more stars.
